application_credentials.description: Create a **Site Access** application at [{developer_url}]({developer_url}) with scopes `SITE_DATA` and `DEVICE_DATA` and Redirect URI `{redirect_url}`, then enter its Client ID and Client Secret here.

auth.title: Sign in to SolarEdge
auth.description:
1. **[Open SolarEdge sign-in]({authorize_url})** (opens a new tab). Sign in with your mySolarEdge homeowner account and approve access.
2. After approving you are sent back to Home Assistant. If that tab shows a blank page or an error, copy the **full address** from its address bar and paste it below.
3. Select **Submit**. If the tab closed by itself, you can leave the field empty.

data.redirect_url: Address you were sent back to

data_description.redirect_url: The full address from the address bar of the tab SolarEdge sent you back to. It contains code= and site_id=.

site.title: SolarEdge site
site.description: Enter the site ID you just granted access to. It is shown in the mySolarEdge app and in the monitoring portal URL.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The SolarEdge authorization has expired or was revoked. Sign in again to continue.

error.missing_code: No authorization code found. Use the sign-in link, then paste the full address you were sent back to.
error.oauth_failed: SolarEdge did not accept the authorization code. Codes are single-use and expire quickly: sign in again with the link and paste the new address.
error.invalid_site: This site was not found or the authorization does not cover it.

abort.wrong_site: You signed in to a different site than the one this entry is for.

init.title: API credit budget
init.description: Every SolarEdge API call costs one credit. Polling intervals are calculated so this budget lasts the whole billing cycle.

data.day_share: Share of power polls during daylight

data_description.monthly_budget: Free tier is 2,000/month. Keep some margin for restarts and other apps on the same developer account.
data_description.billing_day: Day of month your credits reset (the anniversary of your plan start, shown under Usage in the developer console).
data_description.day_share: Percentage of power refreshes spent between sunrise and sunset.
data_description.energy_interval_hours: Hours between lifetime counter fetches. Statistics are backfilled per hour, so a longer interval only delays them.

credits_exhausted.title: SolarEdge API credits exhausted
credits_exhausted.description: The SolarEdge developer account behind {site} has used all of its monthly API credits. Polling is paused and resumes after the billing cycle resets on {reset}. Lower the credit budget in the integration options, or check for other apps using the same developer account.
